snippet.title: Drone Sector - Out Now in Early Access on Steam | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Drone Sector is out now in Early Access on Steam! 🚁

Take command of an advanced aerial weapons platform, blending devastating gunship firepower with real-time squad command. Inspired by the AC-130 gunship and MQ-9 Reaper drone, coordinate allied ground forces, eliminate high-priority threats, and complete objectives across hostile battlefields.

🎮 PLAY NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279440/Drone_Sector/

KEY FEATURES:
- Fluid, responsive gunship combat
- Real-time command of autonomous ground squads
- Color, thermal & night vision camera systems
- Diverse infantry and armored enemies
- Loadout customization & weapon experimentation
- Resource gathering, research & mission progression
- Handcrafted missions with replayable objectives

#DroneSector #EarlyAccess #Steam #MicroProse
